current.messageZh: 火災危險警告為紅色，表示火災危險性極高。
current.messageEn: The Fire Danger Warning is Red and the fire risk is extreme.

forecast.generalSituationZh: 東北季候風會在今明兩日為廣東帶來普遍晴朗及乾燥的天氣，該區早上清涼，日夜溫差頗大。隨著季候風在本週後期稍為緩和，廣東沿岸氣溫回升。預料高空擾動會在星期五及星期六為華南沿岸帶來幾陣驟雨，局部地區有雷暴。受一股偏東氣流影響，下週初廣東沿岸較為潮濕，部分地區能見度較低。而另一股東北季候風會在下週中期影響廣東。
forecast.generalSituationEn: The northeast monsoon will bring generally fine and dry weather to Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be cool in the morning over the region with rather large temperature difference between day and night. With the monsoon moderating slightly in the latter part of this week, temperatures will rise over the coast of Guangdong. Upper-air disturbances are expected to bring a few showers and isolated thunderstorms to the coast of southern China on Friday and Saturday. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be relatively humid with relatively low visibility in some areas over the coast of Guangdong early next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will affect Guangdong midweek next week.

days.weatherEn: Fine and dry. Slightly cooler in the morning.
